title: ADR-067 Amendment — Harness-Layer Technique Revised to Advisory Detection
summary: Partially supersedes ADR-067: the Three-Tier Enforcement Classification's Harness Layer row is amended to describe its two hooks (PostToolUse dispatch log; Stop-hook compound check) as operating in advisory disposition rather than blocking, and the decision-procedure's step 2 and the "only structural defense" State-C claim are revised from impossibility to detectability, reflecting ADR-088's advisory demotion of ADR-064. Substrate primacy is explicitly preserved: the Harness Layer remains primary for phase-boundary and silent-dispatch-fallback mechanisms; only its enforcement strength (not its domain coverage) changes.
workflow_point: Three-Tier Enforcement Classification taxonomy — Harness Layer row and decision-procedure step 2
mechanism: amended Harness-Layer technique description (advisory disposition) and State-C detectability claim; substrate primacy unchanged

links.note: names ADR-060's research-methods-reviewer pre-research-loop dispatch as an example mechanism where Skill-Structure Layer is primary and the Harness Layer adds advisory dispatch-log verification
ADR-063's manifest format is named as the implementing ADR for the Harness Layer substrate row, extended by ADR-064 (as updated by ADR-088) for the compound-check hooks
amends the Harness-Layer classification row to reflect ADR-064's compound-check mechanism as updated by ADR-088
names ADR-065's per-phase skill-anchored dispatch sites as the Skill-Structure-Layer-primary mechanism the Harness Layer's advisory detection complements, per the explicit example list in §5

partially supersedes ADR-067 (IETF Updates analog): amends the Harness Layer row's enforcement-technique description and decision-procedure step 2 language to reflect ADR-088's advisory demotion; the Three-Tier substrate framing, four-step decision procedure structure, and substrate primacy ordering all remain current authority
applies ADR-074's Step 2.5 supersession-header workflow and Step 3 downstream-artifact sweep (deferred to ARCHITECT/BUILD) for the ADR-067 update
